overview|citizen|1|What CivicResolve does|PUBLIC|/|en|what is civicresolve;how does this work;about this app|CivicResolve is a demonstration for submitting and tracking fictional financial complaints. An AI classifier suggests a category and triage priority; a reviewer can check its work. It does not make a binding financial or legal decision.|README.md

submit|citizen|1|Submit a complaint|PUBLIC|/submit|en|submit grievance;file complaint;how to submit;complaint form|Open Submit, describe the financial issue in 20 to 5000 characters, and send the form. Use fictional information in this demonstration. Save the one-time reference and secret shown on the receipt.|frontend/src/features/grievances/SubmitGrievancePage.tsx

details|citizen|1|What to include|PUBLIC|/submit|en|what information;what should i write;complaint details|Describe the product involved, what happened, when it happened, and what outcome you seek. Avoid including account numbers, passwords, or other private information in this demonstration.|frontend/src/features/grievances/SubmitGrievancePage.tsx

categories|citizen|1|Supported categories|PUBLIC|/submit|en|eight categories;product categories;types of complaint|The eight categories are credit reporting or other personal consumer reports, debt collection, credit card, checking or savings account, mortgage, money transfer or virtual currency or money service, vehicle loan or lease, and student loan.|backend/src/main/resources/db/migration/V2__seed_categories.sql

tracking|citizen|1|Track a complaint|PUBLIC|/track|en|track grievance;where is my case;reference;tracking secret|Open Track and enter your reference and one-time tracking secret. The secret is shown only at submission and should be kept private. CivicAssist never needs it. Tracking shows status and a public timeline.|docs/SECURITY.md

status|citizen|1|Complaint statuses|PUBLIC|/track|en|status;pending review;auto routed;approved;overridden;rejected|PENDING_REVIEW means a human check was requested. AUTO_ROUTED means no review trigger was raised. APPROVED confirms the routing; OVERRIDDEN means a reviewer changed category or priority; REJECTED means a reviewer rejected the complaint as invalid. These are workflow states, not legal outcomes.|backend/src/main/java/ai/civicresolve/backend/entity/GrievanceStatus.java

priority|citizen|1|Triage priority|PUBLIC|/track|en|priority;critical;high;medium;low;urgency|LOW, MEDIUM, HIGH and CRITICAL are rule-based triage suggestions. They help order work; they are not legal deadlines or guarantees of resolution.|backend/src/main/java/ai/civicresolve/backend/entity/TriagePriority.java

confidence|model|1|Classification confidence|PUBLIC|/submit|en|confidence;89 percent;probability;prediction|Confidence is the classifier's uncalibrated category estimate. For example, 89% means the model favors one category; it is not an 89% chance that a complaint will be approved. A reviewer can correct the classification.|docs/MODEL_CARD.md

review|citizen|1|Human review|PUBLIC|/track|en|human review;can reviewer change it;override|A reviewer can confirm routing, change the category or priority, or reject an invalid complaint. The original model prediction and reviewer action remain available to authorized reviewers for audit.|backend/src/main/java/ai/civicresolve/backend/service/GrievanceService.java

queue|reviewer|1|Reviewer queue|REVIEWER|/reviewer|en|queue;filter;search;sort;pagination|The reviewer queue lists persisted complaints with server-side searching, filtering, sorting and pagination. Status and priority filters use the backend's supported values. Reviewers can open a case to inspect details.|frontend/src/features/reviewer/ReviewerDashboardPage.tsx

margin|model|1|Top-two probability margin|REVIEWER|/reviewer/grievances|en|margin;top two;uncertainty|The margin is the gap between the two highest category estimates. A small gap indicates the model has less separation between its leading choices. It is not a calibrated measure of correctness.|docs/MODEL_CARD.md

attribution|model|1|Influential words|REVIEWER|/reviewer/grievances|en|feature attribution;influential words;tf idf words|The serving Logistic Regression model can show which TF-IDF words or phrases pushed a category score up or down for a complaint. These are model contributions, not proof of the underlying facts.|docs/MODEL_CARD.md

models|model|1|Serving and challenger models|REVIEWER|/reviewer/audit|en|bilstm;logistic regression;tf idf;challenger;serving model|The serving classifier uses TF-IDF and Logistic Regression for intake. A PyTorch bidirectional LSTM is a reviewer-only challenger for comparison; it does not replace the serving classification. Both require human judgment.|docs/MODEL_CARD.md

audit|reviewer|1|Review audit history|REVIEWER|/reviewer/grievances|en|audit history;review decision;who changed|Authorized reviewers can inspect recorded review actions. Review decisions use optimistic locking and append audit records, so changes to a case remain traceable.|docs/SECURITY.md

analytics|reviewer|1|Analytics|REVIEWER|/reviewer/analytics|en|analytics;metrics;dashboard|The analytics screen summarizes persisted complaint and review data. Counts reflect available records; unavailable measures should not be treated as measured facts.|frontend/src/features/reviewer/ExecutiveAnalyticsPage.tsx

modelaudit|model|1|Model audit|REVIEWER|/reviewer/audit|en|model audit;evaluation;f1;accuracy|The model audit screen presents stored evaluation and comparison information. Accuracy is overall correct classifications; macro F1 weighs each category equally. Historical validation results do not guarantee performance on a new complaint.|docs/MODEL_CARD.md

submit_hi|citizen|1|शिकायत कैसे दर्ज करें|PUBLIC|/submit|hi|शिकायत कैसे दर्ज करें;complaint kaise submit kare;shikayat;submit kaise kare|Submit पेज खोलें और वित्तीय समस्या 20 से 5000 अक्षरों में लिखें। इस डेमो में केवल काल्पनिक जानकारी दें। रसीद पर मिला संदर्भ और गोपनीय कोड सुरक्षित रखें।|frontend/src/features/grievances/SubmitGrievancePage.tsx

tracking_hi|citizen|1|शिकायत की स्थिति|PUBLIC|/track|hi|शिकायत ट्रैक;status kaise dekhe;track kaise kare;reference aur secret|Track पेज पर संदर्भ संख्या और एक बार मिला गोपनीय कोड दर्ज करें। CivicAssist आपसे कोड नहीं माँगता। वहाँ शिकायत की स्थिति और सार्वजनिक समयरेखा दिखती है।|docs/SECURITY.md

confidence_hi|model|1|AI भरोसे का अर्थ|PUBLIC|/submit|hi|confidence kya hai;89 percent ka matlab;ai prediction kya hai|मॉडल का confidence किसी श्रेणी के लिए उसका अनुमान है। यह शिकायत मंजूर होने की संभावना नहीं है। अधिकृत समीक्षक वर्गीकरण बदल सकता है।|docs/MODEL_CARD.md
